frozen_inputs.documents: 31 approved entries; one entry equals one chunk
frozen_inputs.tokenizer: NFKC + casefold; ASCII alphanumeric tokens with lightweight English stemming; each contiguous Chinese sequence plus overlapping Chinese bigrams; no jieba or word segmenter

tie_breakers_in_order: smallest absolute distance from equal weight 1.0

pre_registered_stop_condition.condition: maximum dev query-gold pair hits@5 <= 28 of 45
pre_registered_stop_condition.action_if_true: accept the original equal-weight RRF with embedding_weight=1.0 and stop fusion tuning
pre_registered_stop_condition.action_if_false: freeze the selected weighted RRF and stop fusion tuning

prohibited_changes: no additional weight grid after observing results

notes: This script has no test-split execution path.
The five weights, selection rule, and stopping rule were registered before this run.
No model, RRF k, tokenizer, candidate-set, or reranker change is part of this sweep.
